_: Rung 1 of the fleet ladder: friend request, accept, DM both ways.
This is the journey that has been hardest to debug by hand, because it
needs two machines and it fails in the seam rather than in the protocol:
the request arrives in the provider but the Incoming tab does not show it,
the accept lands but the friend row stays pending, the DM arrives but the
unread pill sits on the wrong side. The Rust harness cannot see any of
that, and one instance cannot produce any of it.
Note step 2: the Accept button only exists on the INCOMING tab. Landing on
the Friends tab and waiting for it is a 30-second timeout that reads like a
delivery failure and is not one - the provider dump in the artifacts says
${RUN} is unique per run and belongs in every message: the relay holds
undelivered traffic for three days and these identities are stable, so a
fixed string can be matched by an earlier run's message.

steps.message: the accepted friend must reach the UI on BOTH sides, not just the friends table
one row per message: the optimistic write and the one that arrives must reconcile

cleanup.message: nothing to undo: every run restores the fixture data directories, so the friendship and the DMs are gone before the next one starts. A server would still need deleting - it lives in other members' state too.
